measurement: Isolated installation outside the project. CodeMirror: esbuild IIFE bundle, minified, ES2020, legal comments retained. EasyMDE: published minified JS + CSS concatenated. gzip level 9. Figures measure the additional library, excluding application UI code; actual full-HTML compression may differ.

currentEditor.description: Native textarea, custom Markdown toolbar and preview using existing marked/DOMPurify.

codeMirrorEssential.configuration: markdownLanguage + markdownKeymap; history, defaultKeymap, historyKeymap; defaultHighlightStyle. No HTML/JS/CSS fenced-code language integration.
codeMirrorEssential.dependencyLicenses: All dependencies included in the measured CodeMirror build declare MIT.

codeMirrorWithHTML.configuration: Same base configuration with markdown() LanguageSupport, which includes nested HTML/JS/CSS support.

exclusions: spell-check dictionaries loaded from a CDN by the default spell-checker
easyMDE.integrationNotes: Disable automatic Font Awesome downloads, reuse existing icons, disable spell-checker or separately vendor its dictionaries. Includes another Marked parser and CodeMirror 5.

recommendation: Keep the current native editor for the minimal first iteration. If live syntax styling and richer editing are wanted next, choose the essential CodeMirror 6 configuration. Both options can be distributed with this MIT project when their required notices are preserved. No editor dependency has been added to the project.
